name: agent-graph
title: Agent Graph
author: AlgorizeTech
description: Ask the user to pick one of 3 agent graph variants: https://avaraui.com/view/agent-graph. This item holds 3 of them as looks of one component (tree, tree-flat, editorial). Skip the question if the user already named one. A hierarchical multi-agent orchestration tree showing live status pills, token budgets, tool integrations, and handoff trails.
docs: Named export: AgentGraph. Accepts `data` (an `AgentGraphNode` tree with `id`, `name`, `model?`, `status`, `message`, `tokensUsed`, `tokensMax`, `color`, `tools?`, `handoff?`, `children?`) and `animateIn`. Fans out horizontally on desktop and collapses into an indented vertical tree on mobile.
